name: WordPress.org deploy
description: Builds and packages the plugin, then deploys it to WordPress.org SVN on each published GitHub release, with the wp-shared-workflows ci-build.yml and cd-wp-org.yml.

inputs.description: WordPress.org plugin slug (must match the slug registered with .org).
Tag or ref of rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows to call. Pin a major tag such as `v1`, never a branch: branches move or get deleted.

Builds the plugin and leaves exactly the files to deploy in dist/plugin (readme.txt at its root). The default builds, packages with `wp-tooling release:zip` (which honours .distignore) and unpacks the zip; python3 is used because self-hosted runners have no unzip.
inputs.default: npm run build:prod && npx @rtcamp/wp-tooling release:zip && python3 -m zipfile -e dist/*.zip dist/package && mv dist/package/*/ dist/plugin

inputs.description: Directory mapped to SVN /assets/ (banners, icons, screenshots). Skipped if it does not exist.

secrets.description: WordPress.org SVN username with commit access to the plugin slug.
Password matching WPORG_USERNAME. Treat as write-only.
